steps.u: Train a churn model on the last 12 months of data and tell me how good it is. Be careful about leakage.

steps.a: cancellation_reason only exists after someone has churned, so it leaks the label. I will drop it and split by time (train on the first 9 months, test on the last 3) instead of a random split, because random splits leak the future into training for time dependent behaviour.

reference.summary: Trained a gradient boosted churn model after removing a label-leaking feature and using a time based split; time split AUC was 0.81 versus an optimistic 0.88 for a random split, and isotonic calibration improved the Brier score from 0.14 to 0.11.
facts: cancellation reason leaked the label and was dropped
isotonic calibration improved Brier from 0.14 to 0.11

decisions.choice: split by time instead of randomly
decisions.reason: random splits leak future behaviour into training and overstate performance
